caption: The video depicts a near-black night sky crossed by a thin vertical wire strung with three warm orange glowing bulbs, spaced top, middle and bottom just left of center, each bright bulb throwing a long diagonal lens-flare streak. The whole scene is peppered with many small bright specks and short motion-blur streaks that drift continuously across the darkness, already moving from the opening moment to the closing one. Individual streaks appear, shift and vanish from moment to moment, forming the dominant moving element. The strand of bulbs holds its vertical arrangement throughout, drifting only slightly, with the bulbs edging a few pixels leftward over time. The diagonal flares remain locked to their bulbs, translating with them rather than moving independently. Three faint green dots sit persistently on the right side, showing no clear independent motion. The change between moments is continuous particle drift plus a very slight shift of the lit strand.
